literal: In the world, as life should be lived, he who lives, heaven-dwelling, among gods to be placed will be.
translation: He who lives in this world exactly as one ought to live will be placed among the gods who dwell in heaven.
modern: இவ்வுலகத்தில் வாழ வேண்டிய அறநெறிப்படி வாழ்பவன், வானத்தில் உறையும் தெய்வங்களுக்குச் சமமாக வைத்துப் போற்றப்படுவான்.
explanation: This couplet concludes the chapter on domestic life by elevating the ideal householder to a divine status. The phrase 'vāḻvāṅku vāḻpavaṉ' refers to a person who fulfills all the duties of family life in this world exactly as they should be done. The word 'vaikkappaṭum' literally means 'will be placed', but here it takes the accepted sense of 'will be ranked' or 'will be considered'. Thus, a person who leads a perfect earthly life is considered equal to the gods who dwell in the heavens.
